title: Coverage reports carry functions, branches and per-test lines, and `nvs test` writes Cobertura beside lcov and Clover
scope:
what a coverage report holds beyond lines: function coverage, branch coverage from a probe on every
conditional edge, a third format under `--coverage-cobertura <FILE>`, the lines each test reached in the
`--format json` document, and the VS Code coverage profile that reads the lcov file. Choosing which files
a report covers, an HTML report and merging the reports of several runs are not decided here.
